fields.statement: QA at 90090bb2, hands-on with the built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh only for pr view, RHIZA_* env unset. Committed a proposed change set, ran rhiza accept in the main clone (entry left untracked), then rhiza run start --foreground: the new worktree showed State: accepted with the accept entry untracked; rhiza ship check passed and rhiza ship land committed and pushed, leaving a clean tree, and the accept entry file was in the pushed branch's tree on origin. For a second change set, a first run set up the worktree while it was proposed, then rhiza accept in the main clone and a second run on the existing worktree showed State: accepted and ship land landed it with the accept on the branch. A third run on the landed worktree copied nothing (clean porcelain, still landed). The same script with a binary built at the merge-base reproduced the bug: the worktree stayed proposed and ship land failed with 'cannot ship change set ...: it is proposed, not accepted'. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-worktree-carries-accept passes.
